context_for_next_testing_agent: HR module now has enhanced employee fields. Key features: 1) Auto-generated employee_code in E001 format, 2) Separate first_name/last_name fields (full_name computed on submit for backward compat), 3) Profile photo upload (3x4), 4) Education fields: education_institution, specialty, admission_date, graduation_date, 5) Contact fields: personal_email, corporate_email, registration_address, 6) Children: children_count with +/- buttons, children_birth_dates array, 7) Documents: criminal_record_scan, health_certificate_scan, document_scans (multi-file), 8) 6 tabs in both Add/Edit modal and Detail view: Şəxsi, Təhsil, Əlaqə, Müqavilə, Əmək haqqı, Sənədlər. Backend accepts dict instead of Pydantic model for flexibility. /api/upload endpoint exists for file uploads.

employee_code_auto_generation.details: POST /api/employees auto-generates employee_code in E001 format. Code increments based on total employee count.

new_personal_fields.details: first_name, last_name, registration_address all working. full_name computed from first_name + last_name on submit.

education_fields.details: education_institution, specialty, admission_date, graduation_date all persisted and displayed correctly.

contact_fields.details: personal_email, corporate_email working. Backward compat: personal_email falls back to email field if not set.

children_fields.details: children_count with +/- buttons, children_birth_dates array. UI dynamically adds/removes date inputs.

document_uploads.details: criminal_record_scan, health_certificate_scan (single file), document_scans (multi-file) all working.

six_tabs_modal.details: Add/Edit modal has 6 tabs: Şəxsi, Təhsil, Əlaqə, Müqavilə, Əmək haqqı, Sənədlər

six_tabs_detail_view.details: Employee detail view has same 6 tabs with InfoCard components displaying all fields.

profile_avatar.details: ProfileAvatar component shows photo_url if exists, else shows initial letter in colored circle.

edit_form_population.details: handleEdit correctly populates all new fields. Legacy employees without first_name/last_name get names split from full_name.
